output:
I'll start by looking at the docs and package layout.

Now I'll apply the fixes, starting with the lexer.

I'll use a Python script for the edits instead.

I fixed the bugs in `layercfg` so it follows the docs. All 56 unit tests pass, and `tools/check.py` reports 0 broken on all 136 configs that resolved. `python -m layercfg run` over `/app/data` exits 0 and refuses 14 configs, each with the error its rules call for.

I also resolved a hand-made config with comments, dotted sections, a shared file, a template section and a `\$` escape. The values came out as the docs describe.

Fixes by file, under `/app/layercfg`:
- **`lexer.py`:**
  - The separator is now whichever of `=` or `:` comes first. It used to prefer `:`.
  - Header, `%include` and whitespace handling only treat spaces and tabs as whitespace.
- **`values.py`:**
  - A `#` only starts an inline comment when it follows a space or tab.
  - `\$` now gives `$$`.
  - Whitespace stripping is limited to spaces and tabs.
- **`loader.py`:**
  - After a shared file, the including file stays in its own section.
  - The include list has no repeats.
- **`interp.py`:**
  - `merge` no longer expands values while reading, so references see final values. A self-reference is now a cycle.
  - A dotted reference name splits at its last dot.
- **`convert.py`:**
  - Durations accept `ms`.
  - `KB`, `MB`, `GB` and `TB` are powers of 1000.
  - List items that are empty are dropped.
- **`report.py`:** Template sections are left out of `settings`, so the summary counts exclude them too.
- **`data.py`:** Files are read as bytes and decoded as UTF-8, so only a line feed splits lines. Before, a lone carriage return also split them.

I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I did not touch `/app/tests`, `/app/data` or `/app/docs`.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat docs/overview.md && wc -l layercfg/*.py docs/*
cd /app && cat docs/syntax.md docs/include.md docs/interp.md docs/types.md docs/output.md docs/changelog.md; ls docs/archive tools data | head -30
cd /app && for f in layercfg/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && sed -n 45,70p docs/include.md; cat docs/interp.md; sed -n 1,12p docs/types.md; cat layercfg/interp.py; sed -n 1,30p layercfg/lexer.py
cd /app && python /tmp/fix.py && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30; git status --short | head

cd /app && sed -n 1,30p tools/check.py | head -40; python tools/check.py --help 2>&1 | head; rm -rf /tmp/o; python -m layercfg run --out /tmp/o; echo rc=$?; cat /tmp/o/errors.json | head -40; ls /tmp/o/resolved | wc -l
cd /app && python tools/check.py; sed -n 40,200p /tmp/o/errors.json | grep error; cat data/schema.json; cat docs/archive/*.md | head -20

mkdir -p /tmp/d/configs /tmp/d/shared && cd /tmp/d && echo '{"types":{"*.n":"int","*.t":"duration","a.b.l":"list"}}' > schema.json && printf '[a.b]
l = x, ,y\
z ,
[A]
n = ${_t.v}
u = $$${k} "q"  # c
k: 5 = 6
v = "\\${k}" 
t = 5ms
color=#fff
col = #fff
%%include s.conf
w = 1
[_t]
v = 0x1_0
' > configs/x.conf && printf '[zz]
q=1
' > shared/s.conf && python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/app')" && PYTHONPATH=/app python -m layercfg resolve x --data /tmp/d

cd /app && cat > STATUS.json <<'E'
{"status": "success", "summary": "Fixed bugs in lexer (separator choice, whitespace handling), values (inline comments, \\$ escape), includes (section restore, include list dedup), interpolation (expansion after merge, dotted section names), conversion (ms unit, 1000-based sizes, list empties), template sections in output and LF-only line splitting. All 56 unit tests and tools/check.py pass."}
E
python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('STATUS.json')))"
